presentationTitle: SPIN Media Annual Awards — “Gawad Parangal at Pagkilala”
presentationSubtitle: Official Event Deck, Selection Framework & Network Broadcast Showcase
themeVerse: 1 Peter 4:10 — “Each of you should use whatever gifts you received to serve others.”

albums.title: Gawad Parangal at Pagkilala 2026 — Awards Deck
albums.description: Complete 11-slide official presentation covering event details, rationale, eight core objectives, seven selection criteria, all seven awardee sectors (A–G), Selection Committee, and participation guide.

slides.title: Official Event Announcement — SPIN Media Annual Awards 2026
slides.caption: Scheduled for December 14, 2026 at Marriott Hotel Pasay City, honoring integrity, transparency, and patriotism across seven national sectors.

slides.title: Official Souvenir Program Cover — Gawad Parangal at Pagkilala
slides.caption: Commemorative Souvenir Program cover celebrating extraordinary Filipinos who exemplify integrity and service in their chosen fields.

slides.title: The Movement — Celebrating the Good & Recognizing Excellence
slides.caption: Gawad Parangal at Pagkilala is a national movement to celebrate the good, recognize excellence, and inspire Filipinos to serve with honor.

slides.title: Rationale of the Awards
slides.caption: Explains why SPIN Media launched Gawad Parangal at Pagkilala: countering divisiveness by spotlighting honest public servants and community leaders.

slides.title: Our Purpose & Eight Core Objectives
slides.caption: Outlines eight institutional goals spanning national recognition, regional chapter award tiers, positive journalism, and public-private alliances.

slides.title: Seven Selection Criteria
slides.caption: Candidates are evaluated on Honesty & Integrity, Transparency & Accountability, Excellence & Innovation, Patriotism, Genuine Service, Positive Impact, and Inspiration.

slides.title: Categories of Awardees — Sectors A to C
slides.caption: Detailed recognition framework for Category A (Government Sector), Category B (Business Sector), and Category C (Law Enforcement & Armed Services: PNP, AFP, Coast Guard, BFP).

slides.title: Categories of Awardees — Sectors D to G
slides.caption: Recognition scopes for Category D (Legislature), Category E (Judiciary & Legal Sector), Category F (Civil Society), and Category G (Religious Sector).

slides.title: Awards Selection Committee
slides.caption: Committee roster led by Chairman Jihan Senina with Romy Redelicia, Randolp Dela Cruz, Achilles Cilo, Gener Bermudez, and Greg Badagwas.

slides.title: My Role & Contribution — Chapter Guide
slides.caption: Six actionable steps for SPIN leaders and chapters covering awardee recommendations, local partnerships, sponsorships, and event coordination.

slides.title: Official Seed of Faith Event & Raffle Ticket
slides.caption: Commemorative Ticket No. 0001 (PHP 500 Seed of Faith) supporting the December 14, 2026 SPIN Media Annual Awards at Marriott Hotel Manila.

slides.title: SPIN TV Media Channel Philippines — Official Brand Banner

slides.title: SPIN Media Updates & Latest Milestones
slides.caption: Highlights six network growth pillars: expanding audience reach, published stories, 5th Annual Awards recognition, stronger partnerships, digital innovation, and purpose.

slides.title: SPIN Media Current Programs — Weekly Lineup (Part 1)
slides.caption: Broadcast schedule spotlighting Unfiltered Commentary (Mon 7 AM), Usapang Mag-Asawa (Tue 7 PM), and Suriin at Timbangin with Freddie Farinas (Thu 7 PM).

slides.title: Live Newsroom & Special Broadcast Coverage Showcase
slides.caption: Highlights live breaking news broadcasts, Senate/SONA special coverages, and nationwide public affairs updates across social platforms.
